say:2:1841117002:0.text: Even after ruling Novaris for centuries, I still haven't quite gotten used to its fickle moon phases.
say:2:1841117002:0.source_cn: 即便余已统治诺珐斯上百年，余依然不适应这变幻的月相。
say:2:1841117002:0.male: Even after ruling Novaris for centuries, I still haven't quite gotten used to its fickle moon phases.
say:2:1841117002:0.female: Even after ruling Novaris for centuries, I still haven't quite gotten used to its fickle moon phases.

say:3:1841117003:0.text: They leave a Graveborn feeling so terribly... sleepy and lazy.
say:3:1841117003:0.source_cn: 着实是……太令亡灵困倦和怠惰了。
say:3:1841117003:0.male: They leave a Graveborn feeling so terribly... sleepy and lazy.
say:3:1841117003:0.female: They leave a Graveborn feeling so terribly... sleepy and lazy.

say:4:1841117004:0.text: When you planted me in the Syndicate, I only agreed because I knew one of the Seven Elders' titles was Sloth.
say:4:1841117004:0.source_cn: 想当初你安插余进入黑金商会时，幸好余恰好知道七长老之中...
say:4:1841117004:0.male: When you planted me in the Syndicate, I only agreed because I knew one of the Seven Elders' titles was Sloth.
say:4:1841117004:0.female: When you planted me in the Syndicate, I only agreed because I knew one of the Seven Elders' titles was Sloth.

say:5:1841117005:0.text: And taking that title has served me well. I've had a fairly easy ten years.
say:5:1841117005:0.source_cn: 也多亏了这名号，这十来年来，余过了一段还算悠闲的日子呢。
say:5:1841117005:0.male: And taking that title has served me well. I've had a fairly easy ten years.
say:5:1841117005:0.female: And taking that title has served me well. I've had a fairly easy ten years.
